properties.statement:
This decision was deferred on 2026-08-14 "as to shape", to be re-opened "when the coverage check is BUILT and one of — (i) a real design is split across an authority boundary and someone needs a parent's number to mean something, (ii) dec:idea-intent-crosses-designs is settled, … or (iii) a second user asks for tiers." Read today: cap:decomposition-coverage-is-asked has status realized (the property, not a run of its check; whether a passing verification backs it was not read). Trigger (iii) was recorded as met on dec:idea-a-graph-whose-children-are-themselves-reflow2-designs on 2026-09-22 ("Alex asked first, on 2026-08-14. Anthony has now asked, in the same shape"), and Anthony asked a third time on 2026-09-26, framing tiers as systems-of-systems levels with an integration design at each. Nothing re-asked it: the trigger is prose on a deferred node, and no mechanism reads it. Re-opening the shape is Anthony's word; this records only that the condition he set is met.

═══ CLOSED 2026-09-26, THE SAME EVENING (valid_to set; nothing above changed) ═══
Retired by doing, not by deciding: Anthony re-opened the deferred question on his word ("Re-open Alex's tiers"). Its status moved from deferred to proposed with him as approver, and it was retitled "RE-OPENED 2026-09-26". It now asks only how tiers LINK, since what a tier HOLDS was settled the same night (req:a-design-over-the-parts-of-one-thing-holds-what-no-part-owns). The observation that no mechanism reads a deferral's re-ask trigger is unaffected by the closing and remains true.
